title: Deterministic local kernel/rootfs image builder and digest-addressed artifact manifests
commit_message: feat(artifacts): build pinned local kernel and rootfs images

deliverables.description: ImageBuilder + ImageManifest + BuildOutput. Verbatim, streaming copy-and-hash of local kernel/rootfs inputs into uncompressed kernel (images/vmlinux) and ext4/rootfs (images/rootfs.ext4) artifacts plus a deterministic image-manifest.json (version, guest_arch, boot_args, per-file SHA-256+size, normalized file:// SourceProvenance). Source gate accepts only local file:// URIs (empty/localhost host) or local paths; remote registries, tag-only refs (nginx:latest, repo/img:tag), digest refs (img@sha256:..), and file://remote-host are rejected with ErrorCode::LocalArtifactRequired. Malformed sources (empty/NUL locator, missing file, directory, symlink, empty file) are rejected with InvalidResourceSpec/ArtifactNotFound. All sources validated before any output is written; no network I/O by construction. Output perms pinned 0o644 (never world-writable) so artifacts pass the PathResolver guard.

QA happy-path integration suite (cargo test -p microvm-artifacts --test reproducible_builder): reproducible builds (identical manifest+file hashes from identical inputs), SHA-256+size coverage for every file incl. the manifest itself, provenance/arch/boot-args/version recording + JSON roundtrip, artifacts open ONLY through the todo-9 PathResolver with digest verification + tamper fail-closed, resolver escape/symlink rejection within the build tree, remote/tag source rejection with LocalArtifactRequired and NO partial output dir, malformed source rejection before any output (incl. valid-kernel/malformed-rootfs leaves no partial kernel), and file:// local-source acceptance with origin normalization.

Wired `pub mod builder;` and re-exported ImageBuilder, ImageManifest, BuildOutput, ArtifactRecord, SourceProvenance, GuestArch, MediaKind, SourceKind, IMAGE_MANIFEST_VERSION, KERNEL_RELPATH, ROOTFS_RELPATH, MANIFEST_RELPATH.
Promoted serde_json from dev-dependency to runtime dependency (manifest serialization); already a workspace dependency, no new external crate.
Added ErrorCode::LocalArtifactRequired (stable string 'local_artifact_required') to the enum, as_str(), and all(); bumped the count assertion 15 -> 16.
Mapped ErrorCode::LocalArtifactRequired -> HTTP 400 BadRequest (client-supplied non-local source; same class as path_escape/binary_provenance_error); updated the deterministic mapping doc table.
Mapped ErrorCode::LocalArtifactRequired -> gRPC InvalidArgument; bumped the total-mapping count assertion 15 -> 16.
Added (LocalArtifactRequired, 400) to the exhaustive deterministic-mapping vector (asserts coverage of all 16 codes).
Added (LocalArtifactRequired, InvalidArgument) to the exhaustive deterministic-mapping vector (asserts coverage of all 16 codes).

acceptance_criteria.two_builds_identical_manifest_and_file_h: reproducible_builds_produce_identical_manifest_and_file_hashes builds the same local inputs into two output dirs and asserts identical manifest_sha256, identical serialized manifest bytes, identical kernel/rootfs file hashes across builds, and that every artifact hash equals its source content hash (verbatim copy); rebuilding_into_the_same_directory_is_stable asserts idempotent rebuild into the same dir.
acceptance_criteria.all_files_have_sha256_and_size: all_files_have_sha256_and_size asserts the kernel and rootfs records carry SHA-256+size matching the on-disk bytes, the provenance digests equal the artifact digests, and the manifest file itself has a matching SHA-256+size in BuildOutput.
acceptance_criteria.non_file_local_digest_source_rejected: remote_and_tag_sources_are_rejected_with_no_output asserts https/http/oci/docker/registry/s3/gs/ftp/ssh/git URIs, registry.local/kernel:latest, nginx:latest, ubuntu:22.04, bare 'fedora', repo/img@sha256:.., and file://remote-host all fail with ErrorCode::LocalArtifactRequired and create NO output directory; the builder performs no network I/O by construction.
acceptance_criteria.malformed_path_rejected_before_output: malformed_sources_are_rejected_before_output asserts missing path (ArtifactNotFound), directory/empty-file/symlink/empty-locator (InvalidResourceSpec) all fail with NO output dir; malformed_rootfs_is_rejected_before_any_kernel_output asserts a valid kernel is NOT written when the rootfs source is malformed (all sources validated before any output).
acceptance_criteria.generated_artifact_opens_only_through_to: generated_artifacts_open_only_through_path_resolver opens images/vmlinux, images/rootfs.ext4, and image-manifest.json via PathResolver::open_root(out).open(rel) and verifies each digest (tamper fails closed with DigestMismatch); resolver_rejects_escape_and_symlink_within_build_tree proves absolute paths, '..' traversal, and a planted symlink are refused (PathEscape), so the artifacts are reachable only through the descriptor-relative resolver.
acceptance_criteria.no_remote_registry_or_tag_only: the source gate has no network code path; tag-only and digest refs are rejected lexically before any I/O. file_uri_local_sources_build_successfully confirms file:// and file://localhost local sources are accepted and normalize to the same origin.

design_notes.verbatim_copy_for_determinism: kernel and rootfs bytes are copied verbatim (streaming copy-and-hash). The builder never regenerates an ext4 filesystem or recompresses a kernel, so artifact bytes - and therefore their SHA-256 digests - are a pure function of the input bytes. The rootfs input is treated as an opaque, ready ext4 image.
design_notes.manifest_is_content_addressed: the manifest carries no wall-clock timestamps and only declared (version, guest_arch, boot_args) or content-derived (per-file SHA-256/size, normalized file:// provenance origin) fields; struct field order fixes serialization order, so identical inputs yield byte-identical manifests.
design_notes.provenance_origin_normalization: both a bare local path and a file:// URI (empty or localhost host) normalize to the same file://<abspath> origin. Reproducibility is defined for identical local inputs (same files); the normalized absolute source path is part of provenance, so manifests are not expected to be byte-identical when only the source path differs.
design_notes.validate_before_output: ImageBuilder::build resolves and validates BOTH sources (metadata-only, no output) before creating the output tree or copying any bytes, so any rejected source leaves no partial artifact directory. The builder has no network code path.
design_notes.opens_only_through_resolver: artifacts are written at stable relative paths that pass validate_relative_path and are opened exclusively via the todo-9 PathResolver (openat2 RESOLVE_BENEATH|NO_SYMLINKS|NO_MAGICLINKS with openat(O_NOFOLLOW) fallback); output perms are pinned 0o644 so they clear the resolver's world-writable guard regardless of umask.
design_notes.new_error_code: ErrorCode::LocalArtifactRequired was added (rather than overloading PathEscape) because source-provenance locality is a distinct semantic from path escape; this required updating the exhaustive rest/grpc mappings and the two contract vectors plus the 15->16 count assertions.

not_tested: a real mkfs.ext4-produced rootfs image (the builder treats the rootfs as an opaque ext4 blob and copies it verbatim; filesystem contents are irrelevant to determinism)
a live remote-registry pull (rejected by construction - the builder has no network code path; rejection is asserted lexically with no output dir)
pre-5.6 openat2 ENOSYS / EOPNOTSUPP fallback for the opened artifacts (covered by the todo-9 PathResolver both_modes tests, not re-exercised here)
non-Linux hosts (the crate is Unix/openat2-specific by design, same as todo 9)
